aurelm_apex_chase.title: Apex Chase
aurelm_apex_chase.description: A maze chase in a city at night, drawn by the GPU renderer at 60 fps: the M car collects the fuel drops while four electric cars hunt it; a NITRO can drains their batteries. iDrive controller or swipes. Parked only.
aurelm_apex_chase.author: custom

aurelm_blackjack.title: Blackjack
aurelm_blackjack.description: Casino blackjack for play credits, drawn by the GPU renderer at 60 fps: a felt table with a leather rail, cards dealt from the shoe, chips, six decks, 3 to 2, double, split, insurance, a strategy hint, statistics. iDrive controller or touch. Parked only.
aurelm_blackjack.author: custom

aurelm_lap_record.title: Lap Record
aurelm_lap_record.description: Time trial on a circuit seen from above, the camera on the car: the knob is the steering wheel, lap after lap against your best and its ghost, the gap live, sectors in purple, green and yellow. Two circuits, kerbs, gravel, tyre walls, grandstands, tyre smoke and marks. GPU renderer. Parked only.
aurelm_lap_record.author: custom

aurelm_lucky_sevens.title: Lucky Sevens
aurelm_lucky_sevens.description: A five reel slot machine for play credits, drawn by the GPU renderer at 60 fps: glossy symbols, reels that bounce to a stop, ten paylines, WILD, free spins, a progressive jackpot, statistics. iDrive controller or touch. Parked only.
aurelm_lucky_sevens.author: custom

aurelm_pinball.title: M Pinball
aurelm_pinball.description: A pinball table on the circuit: wheels for bumpers, the CHICANE ramp, the PIT LANE, the M-POWER targets and SAFETY CAR MULTIBALL, seen in perspective with real ball physics; drawn by the GPU renderer at 60 fps. Flippers on the controller or a finger on each half of the table. Parked only.
aurelm_pinball.author: custom

aurelm_pit_wall.title: Pit Wall
aurelm_pit_wall.description: Break the advertising panels off the pit wall: a night race scene drawn by the GPU renderer at 60 fps, the ball on an M front wing, start lights, combos and power-ups. iDrive controller or touch. Parked only.
aurelm_pit_wall.author: custom

aurelm_ridge_duel.title: Ridge Duel
aurelm_ridge_duel.description: Two armed cars on hills at dusk, a turn each: aim with the knob, hold for power, fire. Ground that shells bite into, wind, four kinds of shell, a rival aimed by the game. Your car: a sport sedan (agile) or a performance SUV (armoured), in your colour. GPU renderer. Parked only.
aurelm_ridge_duel.author: custom

aurelm_snake.title: Snake
aurelm_snake.description: Snake on the central display, drawn by the GPU renderer at 60 fps: steer with the iDrive controller (push or turn) or swipe on the screen. Parked only.
aurelm_snake.author: custom

aurelm_solitaire.title: Solitaire
aurelm_solitaire.description: Klondike solitaire drawn by the GPU renderer at 60 fps: a felt card table, cards that fly, flip and bounce home. Tap or press for the best move, drag cards, draw one or three, undo, hint, auto finish, statistics. Parked only.
aurelm_solitaire.author: custom

aurelm_street_siege.title: Street Siege
aurelm_street_siege.description: Defend the M garage: cars storm an industrial yard at night and the M car stops them with its roof cannon. Tyre walls that fall apart, concrete, a canal, trees, oil, power-ups; drawn by the GPU renderer at 60 fps. Parked only.
aurelm_street_siege.author: custom

aurelm_track_defender.title: Track Defender
aurelm_track_defender.description: Arcade shooter on the central display, drawn by the GPU renderer at 60 fps: drones attack the track in waves, the M car shoots them down. iDrive controller or touch. Parked only.
aurelm_track_defender.author: custom
